problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the annual infrastructure budget across 20 different development projects to maximize the overall community benefit score.  
The profile for each project is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.072, complexity index 0.028, allocation limits [0.031, 0.499]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.194, complexity index 0.234, allocation limits [0.056, 0.429]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.079, complexity index 0.086, allocation limits [0.002, 0.740]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.139, complexity index 0.102, allocation limits [0.067, 0.864]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.041, complexity index 0.123, allocation limits [0.075, 0.322]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.104, complexity index 0.138, allocation limits [0.008, 0.312]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.077, complexity index 0.126, allocation limits [0.066, 0.864]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.040, complexity index 0.275, allocation limits [0.085, 0.362]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.145, complexity index 0.088, allocation limits [0.071, 0.539]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.147, complexity index 0.221, allocation limits [0.052, 0.591]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.159, complexity index 0.109, allocation limits [0.061, 0.394]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.107, complexity index 0.247, allocation limits [0.048, 0.481]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.165, complexity index 0.099, allocation limits [0.034, 0.438]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.108, complexity index 0.129, allocation limits [0.018, 0.763]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.094, complexity index 0.176, allocation limits [0.015, 0.448]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.062, complexity index 0.058, allocation limits [0.050, 0.463]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.072, complexity index 0.070, allocation limits [0.080, 0.374]  
* Project R: benefit score 0.111, complexity index 0.191, allocation limits [0.021, 0.770]  
* Project S: benefit score 0.180, complexity index 0.285, allocation limits [0.075, 0.693]  
* Project T: benefit score 0.161, complexity index 0.188, allocation limits [0.085, 0.379]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified allocation limits, and the sum of all budget shares must equal the total budget of 1. To ensure rapid implementation, the planner requires that the group of quick-deployment projects, represented by the subset Q = {A, C, I, L, N, O, Q, S, T}, collectively receive at least 0.425 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall portfolio complexity, measured by a composite complexity index, must not exceed 0.215, and the total community benefit score must be at least 0.075.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total community benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
